scope: PC movement input, scalar tuning, bounded gravity/jump/velocity and prediction contracts. Original isolated x86 corroboration; not complete live locomotion or collision equivalence.

input.deadzoneRule: Set both components to zero below squared radius, independent of lower-level pad deadzone16.
input.dpadRule: Any directional bit makes D-pad override analog. Left beats right, down beats up if both held. Each component is -127.5,0,+127.5.
input.normalization: Multiply axes by float32(2/255), recover angle by native atan table, rotate a vector of length max(abs(x),abs(z)) by that angle, then measure its XZ length.
input.restrictedWalk: Model flags+4 bit0x20 and low-health branch force walk_speed for nonzero input. Exact PC branches retained in source; tested player index=-1,current HP<=2 branch.

outputs.direction: gamepad+0x2c/+0x30; PC player and AI paths store components differently

input.validation: All 65,536 physical byte pairs plus 528 band-flag and D-pad cases; exact selected float32 speeds.

timeAndUnits.evidence: 0x428b90 assigns initial dt=1/60 or1/50 by region flag, default dt=1/60, maxdt=.1. 0x492b40 obtains frame-end dt and conditionally clamps to maxdt. 0x416d60 forms displacement=velocity*dt and commits resolved position/velocity.
timeAndUnits.coordinateUnit: Shared source scene/TER unit. No evidence establishes a conversion to meters.

contracts.ordinaryTargetVelocity: vx=desiredSpeed*sin16(movementYaw); vz=desiredSpeed*cos16(movementYaw). Numerous context, animation, material, vehicle and character overrides remain in the native function.
contracts.smoothing: vNext=v+min(float32(dt*rate),1)*(target-v); rate usually gameCharacter+0x44, modified by context and surface friction. This is proportional velocity approach, not constant physical acceleration.
contracts.gravity: For ordinary nonhovering context and groundFlags0 or2: vyNext=vy+gravity*dt. With zero hover height and groundFlags bit0 set: vy=0. Other flags/context guards can suppress updates.
contracts.jump: 0x561ba0 copies jump_speed into vy, clears ground flags and counters, sets jump-held runtime bit, initializes jump context/sequence and resets animation packet.
contracts.secondJump: 0x562570 consumes gameCharacter+0x38 (jump_2_speed) in second-jump branches; full eligibility, audio and animation state machine not emulated.
contracts.jumpHeightAssist: remaining=targetHeight-(collisionMinY-jumpStartHeight); if positive targetVy=sqrt(-2*gravity*remaining). Apply if forced or targetVy>currentVy; forced nonpositive remaining sets vy=0.
contracts.holdJump: ApplyGravity context0/action5: while Jump held, variant2 freezes vy=0; variant3 uses gravity=-1. If a held normal ascent crosses vy<=0 and hover_time>0, set vy=0,timer=hover_time*(player?1:1.5),variant2; otherwise variant3. Button release clears hold timer and exits variant2.
contracts.collisionPrediction: Ordinary GameObjectOrigin computes predicted collision center = position + previousVelocity*dt, with Y additionally offset by (characterBottom+characterTop)*scale/2. Terrain collision later resolves displacement and commits actual position.

numericParser.grammar: Optional minus, decimal digits, optional dot and decimal digits. Stop at first other character. No plus, exponent or leading whitespace accepted by converter (word tokenizer handles leading spaces).
numericParser.arithmetic: Float32 multiplication by10, then float32 addition of digit; denominator multiplies by10 per fractional digit; final float32 division.
numericParser.corpus: 139 distinct observed tokens; all1831 native scalar setter call chains matched exactfloat32bits. Falumpaset source suffixes ___3.887 terminate conversion after prefix; retained as numericPrefixAccepted.

limitations: Native cases use synthetic bounded state; no complete directional context dispatcher, contacts or live gameplay were emulated.
Only the selected scalar handlers are folded into tuning records, preserving assignment history and source lines. Missing defaults and script overrides are not guessed.
jump_speed_double is retained as unresolved legacy text: actual PC table entry 0x8045c0 maps jump_2_speed to 0x587780; those strings must not be conflated.
General camera-relative angle contract is documented separately in native-input-camera.json.
